items.title: Ogden Valley weather: Nov. 1 to 6
items.summary: A soaking Sunday: rain turning to showers and thunderstorms (100%), with about three-quarters of an inch to an inch of rain possible and a high near 50°. A chance of light rain Monday through Wednesday (36–44%), then drier and sunnier by Thursday. Lows of 29–32° Monday through Friday nights, so cover tender plants and unhook hoses. Snow level near 6,600 feet, so the peaks may turn white while the Valley floor stays rain. Starting as early as Monday, Nov. 2, and through April, one lane of SR-39 in upper Ogden Canyon is closed, with alternating traffic around the clock. Air quality is Good.
items.alt: Ogden Valley weather briefing for Nov. 1 to 6: a six-day forecast with Sunday highlighted at 100 percent, plus boxes on a soaking Sunday, frosty nights, snow up high, the Ogden Canyon lane closure, and a get-ready list.
items.source: National Weather Service point forecast for the Eden, Liberty and Huntsville area, issued 12:31 a.m. Nov. 1, 2026; UDOT Traffic (SR-39); Utah Division of Air Quality forecast, issued 7:32 p.m. Oct. 31

items.title: Ogden Valley weather: Oct. 29 to Nov. 4
items.summary: Dry and mild today and early Friday, highs near 61°. Rain chances start Friday afternoon and evening (52%). Halloween looks wet: light rain Saturday turning to showers and thunderstorms by evening (99%), highs near 58°, so plan trick-or-treating with rain gear. Sunday, Nov. 1, brings showers and thunderstorms, then rain and snow likely Sunday night, with a chance of rain and snow Monday morning; lows near 29–31°. Snow level near 8,000 feet. Mostly sunny Tuesday and Wednesday, highs in the 50s. Air quality is Good. Clocks fall back one hour early Sunday, Nov. 1.
items.alt: Ogden Valley weather briefing for Oct. 29 to Nov. 4: a six-day forecast with Saturday and Sunday highlighted at 99 percent, plus boxes on a wet Halloween, rain and snow Sunday night, clocks falling back, and drying out, and a get-ready list.
items.source: National Weather Service point forecast for the Eden, Liberty and Huntsville area, issued 12:31 a.m. Oct. 29, 2026; Utah Division of Air Quality forecast, issued 3:31 p.m. Oct. 28

items.title: Ogden Valley weather update: Oct. 13–18
items.summary: Showers and thunderstorms tonight and Tuesday (94% chance Tuesday), with the snow level near 7,300 feet so the high peaks may turn white while the Valley floor stays rain. Lows of 29–32° every night through Friday, so cover tender plants and unhook hoses. Dry and sunny Thursday through Sunday, warming to the mid-60s. Air quality is Good.
items.alt: Ogden Valley weather update for Oct. 13 to 18: a six-day forecast with Tuesday wet at 94 percent, then sunny Thursday through Sunday, plus boxes on showers and thunder, frost nights, snow up high, a sunny weekend, and a get-ready checklist.
items.source: National Weather Service point forecast for the Eden, Liberty and Huntsville area, issued 10:01 p.m. Oct. 12, 2026; Utah Division of Air Quality forecast, issued 6:27 p.m. Oct. 12

items.title: Ogden Valley storm briefing: Oct. 9–14
items.summary: Leftovers of Tropical Storm Rachel. Wettest day Sunday, Oct. 11, with 1 to 3 inches of rain late Saturday to Monday morning, creeks running fast by Sunday evening, and snow levels dropping to 8,500–9,000 feet Monday to Wednesday.
items.alt: Ogden Valley storm briefing for Oct. 9 to 14: a six-day forecast with Sunday the wettest day, plus boxes on heavy rain, creeks and roads, wind, snow up high, and a get-ready checklist.
items.source: National Weather Service Salt Lake City forecast discussion, issued 2:55 p.m. Oct. 8, 2026; KSL and KUTV, Oct. 8
